models.name: Isolation Forest
models.implementation: original algorithm via sklearn; exact trees exported
models.source: FORCE public observation subset plus explicitly injected spikes

split.policy: entire wells disjoint; validation/test anomalies are controlled injected spikes

limitations: Non-injected rows are not expert-confirmed normal. Metrics only measure artificial spike identification, not field anomaly accuracy.
No true production anomaly is smoothed or rewritten.

models.name: RotatE
models.implementation: complex rotations, self-adversarial negative sampling; small transductive experiment

split.policy: triples disjoint; all held-out endpoints/relations covered in train; checkpoint selected by validation MRR

validation.protocol: filtered head+tail ranking over all entities

test.protocol: filtered head+tail ranking over all entities

limitations: 591 source relations: process demonstration, not industrial validation.
A link score proposes an association; it does not establish hydraulic connectivity or causal effect.
Full graph contains held-out edges and must never be used as training input.

models.name: GRIN精简结构复现
models.implementation: bidirectional mask-aware graph-message GRU reconstruction; compact structural reproduction, not official pretrained GRIN
models.source: Volve public daily arrays, artificial masking of known observed cells

split.policy: global chronological split; 14-record nonoverlapping windows stay within each split; train-only normalization/statistical adjacency

limitations: Compact reproduction rather than original authors checkpoint.
Natural missing cells have no ground truth; scores only use artificially held-out known observations.
Graph is statistical and does not prove injection/production connectivity.
Frozen held-out inference traces; browser does not run this Torch checkpoint live.
Professional rules must retain/flag physically invalid predictions; outputs are not silently clipped.

models.name: 本体约束UIE式精简抽取模型
models.implementation: prompt-conditioned 2-layer Transformer with start/end span heads; UIE-style compact structural reproduction, NOT official UIE pretrained weights
models.source: Chinese template summaries generated from actual Volve monthly table facts; programmatic exact-span labels

split.policy: documents/time split; different templates by split; all schema prompts of a document remain together; train-only char vocabulary; 8 shuffled field-order variants generated from TRAIN facts only

validation.protocol: one predicted span per schema prompt, exact start/end match; all prompts remain grouped by document/time split

test.protocol: one predicted span per schema prompt, exact start/end match; all prompts remain grouped by document/time split

limitations: Not an official pretrained UIE checkpoint; small trained structural reproduction.
298 programmatically generated template documents, not independently annotated real reports.
Span exact-match on templates does not establish free-form production report extraction performance.
Frozen held-out predictions, not live browser inference.
Ontology constraint here is a closed entity/relation prompt schema; full OWL axiom reasoning is not implemented.
Final exact-span F1 remains ~0.332 on held-out generated templates; require manual review, not unattended extraction.

models.name: Anomaly Transformer精简结构复现
models.implementation: two association-attention layers, learned Gaussian prior, series/prior minimax discrepancy, reconstruction-weighted anomaly score; compact reproduction, not authors checkpoint
models.source: real Volve per-well production windows; controlled perturbations only for labeled evaluation

split.policy: chronological split; no window crosses split; scaler/imputer fit training only; validation reconstruction selects checkpoint and controlled labels select threshold

limitations: Compact trained structural reproduction rather than authors official checkpoint.
Precision/recall/AUC refer only to controlled constructed perturbations. Unmodified real windows are not expert-confirmed normal.
Frozen held-out outputs; no live browser Torch inference.
Natural production event detection cannot establish root cause or treatment effects.
Controlled shifts retain nonnegative production and bounded water-cut; still not independently confirmed field events.
Windows contain 32 source records and may span calendar gaps. Natural input gaps use train-only median and are flagged in source_observed_mask.

evaluation_policy: Training-only fitting and normalization; validation selects checkpoints/thresholds; test never used for fitting. No field-root-cause accuracy claims.

rule_baseline.name: 本体闭集规则解析基线
rule_baseline.implementation: deterministic schema patterns, explicitly NOT UIE predictions

train.scope: Generated public-table template corpus only; not free-form report performance

validation.scope: Generated public-table template corpus only; not free-form report performance

test.scope: Generated public-table template corpus only; not free-form report performance

limitations: Template corpus only; 1.0 F1 is not real-report or neural-model accuracy.
